videoAnalyses.title: 16 - Chest and Triceps A
videoAnalyses.summary: This video presents a 20-minute chest and triceps workout routine. It features five different exercises, each performed for multiple sets of 10 repetitions, with 60-second rest intervals between sets.

videoAnalyses.title: 17 - Chest and Triceps B
videoAnalyses.summary: This video provides a 30-minute chest and triceps workout routine consisting of seven different exercises. Each exercise is performed for three sets of 10 repetitions, with a 60-second rest period between each set.

curriculum.targetTransformation: Build shoulders and chest that actually show

lessons.title: Press and fly your chest with dumbbells using correct set and rep structure
lessons.summary: Learners establish the foundational chest workout pattern by following Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes across 3 sets of 10 reps each, with 60-second rest intervals.

sessions.title: Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes — Foundations
sessions.summary: Execute the first two dumbbell chest exercises in sequence, mastering the 3×10 set structure with 60-second rests.

steps.title: Log your Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes sets before moving on
Reflect on how the Flat Bench Dumbbell Press and Dumbbell Flyes felt across all three sets

clips.chapterTitle: Flat Bench Dumbbell Press — 3 Sets of 10

lessons.title: Hit every chest angle with machine and cable chest exercises
lessons.summary: Learners build on their dumbbell foundation by working through Machine Chest Press, Low Pulley Cable Fly, Machine Chest Fly, and Decline Cable Crossover — all for 3 sets of 10 reps with 60-second rests.

sessions.title: Machine Press, Cable Fly, Machine Fly, and Decline Crossover — Full Chest Coverage
sessions.summary: Work through four machine and cable chest exercises in sequence, each for 3 sets of 10 reps with 60-second rest periods, covering every chest angle.

steps.title: Track your weight and rep completion for all four machine and cable chest exercises
Reflect on how machine and cable exercises compare to the dumbbell work from Lesson 1

clips.chapterTitle: Machine Chest Press, Low Pulley Cable Fly, Machine Chest Fly, and Decline Cable Crossover — 3×10 Each

lessons.title: Finish your chest workout with push-ups and cable crossovers for complete muscle fatigue
lessons.summary: Learners complete the Workout A chest block by performing Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover — each for 3 sets of 10 reps — learning to close out a chest session effectively.

sessions.title: Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover — Closing the Chest Session
sessions.summary: Execute the final two exercises of Chest and Triceps Workout A — Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover — each for 3 sets of 10 reps with 60-second rests.

steps.title: Complete Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover and log how fatigue changed across sets
Reflect on how the Decline Cable Crossover and Bench Push-Up serve as session finishers

clips.chapterTitle: Bench Push-Ups and Decline Cable Crossover — 3×10 Each

lessons.title: Isolate and exhaust your triceps with dips and cable pushdowns to finish the program
lessons.summary: Learners complete the full upper body program by executing the dedicated triceps block from Workout B — Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdown — each for 3 sets of 10 reps, learning how to isolate triceps after the chest work is done.

sessions.title: Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdown — Dedicated Triceps Finisher
sessions.summary: Execute the triceps-only block from Chest and Triceps Workout B — Triceps Bench Dips followed by Cable Rope Pushdown — each for 3 sets of 10 reps with 60-second rests.

steps.title: Perform Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdown and record your set-by-set output
Reflect on how the Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdown complete your chest and triceps training

clips.chapterTitle: Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdown — 3×10 Each
